resolution.note: screening commands (cleanEnv) and arm sessions (armEnv) run with stub openers first on PATH, BROWSER at the stub, no DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY and the bus at a missing path; tests in screening-units and replay-live

title: Screen grading and sessions never open the host browser
body:
Source: operator report 2026-11-17: Chrome opened https://ko-fi.com/pelpsi at 03:28, 03:30 and 04:06 (history transition 6, external launch). Cause: gold-run grading of units t-fd481gz and t-obh9z0b (simonepelosi/vibez) ran go test ./internal/tui/, whose code calls openurl.Open("https://ko-fi.com/pelpsi"); xdg-open reached the desktop session.
Fix: screening install/test commands and arm sessions run with a PATH stub dir whose xdg-open, open, sensible-browser, x-www-browser and gio log the URL and exit 0, BROWSER set to that stub, and DISPLAY, WAYLAND_DISPLAY and DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS cleared (bus pointed at a nonexistent path).
Outcome: a grading test whose command runs xdg-open https://example.invalid exits 0, the URL lands in the stub log, and no browser starts.
Proof: test/evals/screening-units.test.ts asserts the stub log line and that the command saw no DISPLAY, WAYLAND_DISPLAY or real bus.
